method: Independent divisions/conferences. Fixed Ridge alpha=10 and logistic C=1; Elo and equal ensemble. Earlier seasons train, preceding season first UTC-day half calibrates score scale, second half selects by log loss, refit on all preceding seasons. No target-season tuning; same-day features withheld.
limitations: Retrospectively collected numeric results; publication-time history and independently complete coverage unavailable. PBA nominal sides are not verified home court. League reorganisation, imports and rule changes are not fully modeled. Historical accuracy is not a prospective or guaranteed rate. Intervals are not conditional coverage guarantees. Small/partial seasons and selected coverage are separate.
